propositions: Automated quality audit identified approved maintainability ratchets that cannot be enforced wholesale without resolving existing diagnostics in function complexity, Mypy settings (no_implicit_optional, strict_equality, warn_redundant_casts, warn_unused_ignores), Ruff ASYNC/DTZ, and Ruff RUF families.
Four child stories must execute in dependency order (d9f5 → 28cd → 125d) to coordinate pyproject.toml edits and shared test ownership (test_ruff_ratchet.py created by 28cd, extended by 125d).

Every newly-enforced gate must exit 0 against current origin/main before landing, and all pre-existing diagnostics in each ratchet family present on origin/main (including drift introduced after story baselines) must be resolved or baselined before the corresponding gate lands.

C901 complexity gate wraps a symbol-level shrink-only baseline at threshold 15 and integrates into the canonical lint gate; complexity story (c9f7) may proceed independently when no file-impact conflict is reported.
